name: section-accordion
title: Section Accordion
description: A sectioned accordion where each section has a title, a description, and arbitrary content. Only one section opens at a time; sections can be disabled. Includes a composed Section Accordion.Group. Built on Radix Accordion.

docs.lead: A sectioned accordion for grouping arbitrary content under collapsible headers. Each section has a title and a description, only one opens at a time, and sections can be disabled. Built on Radix Accordion for full accessibility.
docs.usage:
import * as SectionAccordion from "@/components/ui/section-accordion"

<SectionAccordion.Root defaultValue="a">
  <SectionAccordion.Item value="a">
    <SectionAccordion.Header>
      <SectionAccordion.Trigger>
        <SectionAccordion.Heading>
          <SectionAccordion.Title>Title</SectionAccordion.Title>
          <SectionAccordion.Description>2 Lessons</SectionAccordion.Description>
        </SectionAccordion.Heading>
        <SectionAccordion.Chevron />
      </SectionAccordion.Trigger>
    </SectionAccordion.Header>
    <SectionAccordion.Content>Content</SectionAccordion.Content>
  </SectionAccordion.Item>
</SectionAccordion.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: A sectioned accordion built from the primitives. Only one section opens at a time — opening a closed section closes the open one. The last section is disabled.
examples.code:
<SectionAccordion.Root defaultValue='idea-validation'>
  <SectionAccordion.Item value='idea-validation'>
    <SectionAccordion.Header>
      <SectionAccordion.Trigger>
        <SectionAccordion.Heading>
          <SectionAccordion.Title>Idea Validation & Market Research</SectionAccordion.Title>
          <SectionAccordion.Description>8 Lessons</SectionAccordion.Description>
        </SectionAccordion.Heading>
        <SectionAccordion.Chevron />
      </SectionAccordion.Trigger>
    </SectionAccordion.Header>
    <SectionAccordion.Content>
      {/* arbitrary content, e.g. lesson rows */}
    </SectionAccordion.Content>
  </SectionAccordion.Item>
</SectionAccordion.Root>

examples.title: Group (Composed)
examples.description: The composed Section Accordion.Group renders sections from an array of items — the quickest way to use the component. Handles the header, chevron, and content layout automatically.
examples.code:
<SectionAccordion.Group
  defaultValue='idea-validation'
  items={[
    { value: 'welcome', title: 'Welcome & Foundations', description: '2 Lessons', content: <Lessons /> },
    { value: 'idea-validation', title: 'Idea Validation & Market Research', description: '8 Lessons', content: <Lessons /> },
    { value: 'launch', title: 'Launch & Go-to-Market', description: '5 Lessons', disabled: true, content: null },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Arbitrary Content
examples.description: Section content can be any React node — cards, forms, lists, or plain text.

api.name: SectionAccordion.Root
api.description: The bordered container that holds the sections. Wraps Radix Accordion.Root, defaulting to type='single' collapsible so only one section is open at a time. Pass defaultValue / value to control which section is open.

props.name: type
props.description: Whether one or multiple sections can be open at a time

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When type is 'single', allows closing the open section

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the section open by default (uncontrolled)

api.name: SectionAccordion.Item
api.description: An individual section. Fills with a subtle background when open.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, the section cannot be opened and renders in a muted state

api.name: SectionAccordion.Header
api.description: Wraps the trigger in a heading element for accessibility. Wraps Radix Accordion.Header.

api.name: SectionAccordion.Trigger
api.description: The clickable header row that toggles the section. Lay out a Heading and a Chevron inside it.

api.name: SectionAccordion.Heading
api.description: Vertical stack for the title and description.

api.name: SectionAccordion.Description
api.description: The secondary description line (e.g. '8 Lessons'). Brightens from soft to sub color when its section is open.

api.name: SectionAccordion.Chevron
api.description: The boxed toggle indicator on the right of the header. Rotates 180° when the section is open.

props.name: icon
props.description: The chevron icon component to render

api.name: SectionAccordion.Content
api.description: The collapsible body with slide animation. Renders arbitrary children.

api.name: SectionAccordion.Group
api.description: Composed sectioned accordion that renders sections from props. Handles the header, chevron, and content layout automatically.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of sections with value, title, optional description, content, and optional disabled

props.name: chevronIcon
props.description: The chevron icon component rendered in every section header

props.name: type
props.description: Whether one or multiple sections can be open at a time

props.name: collapsible
props.description: When type is 'single', allows closing the open section
